basics.name: Kyle Devereaux Nel
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · TypeScript / React / Node.js / PHP · DevOps
basics.summary:
I'm a down-to-earth engineer who loves the web. I'm good with people, and I look past the code to the bigger picture: what the business actually needs, how a project or tool should be architected, and which unknowns are going to catch us out later. I do my best work in a team, helping everyone else do theirs. I want to build useful things, not generic ones: apps that solve a real business problem and websites that make a difference.

Over 10+ years I've worked across product engineering, DevOps, technical support and leadership, including six years at Automattic (WooCommerce.com and WordPress.com) and four as Technical Director of a UK agency.
basics.x-workRights: Dual South African and British citizen; right to work in South Africa and the UK. Timezone UTC+2. Open to remote or WFH-led hybrid.

support.label: Technical Support Lead · Support Engineering · Web, Hosting & SaaS
support.summary:
I'm a down-to-earth support lead and engineer who loves the web. I've worked on both sides of the ticket: five years as a senior escalation engineer for WordPress.com's enterprise and VIP customers, and years building the sites and tools customers rely on. I'm good with people, and I look past the immediate fix to the bigger picture: what keeps going wrong, what should be self-service, and which unknowns are going to catch the team out later. I do my best work leading a team and helping everyone in it do their best.

Over 10+ years I've managed a customer support team, run engineering and support at a UK agency, and built contact-centre and self-service tools. I'm comfortable explaining technical problems to customers, engineers and management alike.

work.name: IGrow Group of Companies
work.summary: Senior developer across IGrow's four brands (Investments, Rentals, Real Estate International and Execu Move). I worked directly with management, marketing and the contact centre, and mentored the other three developers.
highlights: Rebuilt rentals.igrow.co.za on a custom theme with proper caching. GTmetrix grades went from E/F to A/B, and server load fell even as traffic grew in the months after launch.
Integrated the site with PropData, pulling in 200+ property listings on a schedule and keeping details and availability in sync.

Built a viewing-booking tool for the contact centre, tied into Zoho CRM for user accounts, leads and bookings. It's used by 25+ contact-centre staff, 10 rental agents and management (with role-based access) for 30+ bookings a day across 200 properties. Prospective tenants could also book viewings themselves, which took people out of a bottleneck to improve booking rates.

Scoped an agent roster generator to replace manual scheduling: agents grouped by area, a rules engine, and real Google Maps travel times to fit more viewings into each day, plus reporting for management.
Started a shared Web Components library for use across all four brands.
Set up and ran the Linux servers for the apps I built, with GitHub Actions pipelines running smoke and synthetic tests before every deploy.

Brought AI into the team's workflow: landing pages generated from briefs, brief-to-pull-request automation and automated code review. I handled the architecture and reviewed what the AI produced, and rebuilds that used to take months took days or weeks.

Built automations in Zoho Flow, SalesIQ and Zapier, and wrote direct API integrations where speed, security or data quality mattered. Worked with marketing to track ad spend and lead sources properly.
Cleaned up the WordPress sites: brought them up to date, removed plugins we didn't need and replaced them with our own code.
Set up Linear and the engineering workflow from scratch, then helped move the team to Jira.
